name: hive-desktop
description: Hive (MissionControlAI) desktop — Tauri v2 shell running the Next standalone server + the embedded-terminal server as Node sidecars.

scripts.//: Build the macOS app/.dmg. `assemble` stages the Next standalone runtime, the terminal runtime, and the bundled node binary into src-tauri/ before `tauri build`. See scripts/build-desktop.sh and README.md.
